title: Air quality in Kaunas
attribution: Data.europa.eu metadata for the Lithuanian open-data catalogue record “Air quality in Kaunas”.

metadataLicense.scope: The public portal metadata; not the underlying air-quality observations.

underlyingDataLicense.evidence: dct:license statements of all four distributions in source-response.ttl. Underlying observations are not downloaded or redistributed.

response.scope: Exact UTF-8 SPARQL CONSTRUCT response: all direct statements about this dataset and its four distributions. This is a graph slice, not the complete upstream catalogue; linked vocabulary, publisher/contact and quality-measurement node descriptions are not traversed.

extraction.method: Select only the predicates listed here; retain untagged and en literals. Preserve RDF terms exactly; sort and serialize as N-Triples. Do not add missing type triples or invent facts.
extraction.excluded: Other languages, contact/publisher links, quality metrics, other non-import fields and linked resource descriptions. No individual contact details are included in the projection.

officialProfile.scope: Unmodified DCAT-AP 3.0.0 base shapes only; no additional vocabulary graph or inference layer.

applicationProfile.name: MoonSHACL local catalogue-import profile
applicationProfile.scope: Require title/description, linked typed distributions, HTTP(S) access/download IRIs, and format/licence IRIs. Does not claim complete DCAT-AP validation.

transaction.errorInjection: Delete the existing CSV distribution accessURL from a local candidate.
transaction.repair: Atomically replace that accessURL with the same distribution’s existing downloadURL. This is a local access-entry policy change supported by a published source URL, not an upstream data correction or an assertion that the portal changed.
